)

  Driver_Id int -- Unique auto-generated identifier for a driver in the driverlist master table. Primary key for internal driver identification.,

  Contact_Number1 bigint -- Primary telephone number of the driver. Corresponds to tripbooking.Driver_Contact1 for the driver assigned to a trip.,
  Contact_Number2 bigint -- Secondary or alternate telephone number of the driver. Corresponds to tripbooking.Driver_Contact2 when available.,
  WhatsApp_Number bigint -- WhatsApp-enabled telephone number for contacting the driver.,
